title: Diaper Cakes
description: Built to order and made to be taken apart — every tier is rolled nappies, banded in ribbon and burlap over a hessian nest, with a foil monogram at the top. Sized to the shower and finished in whatever palette the rest of the room is running.

alt.blue-and-white-diaper-cake.jpg: A three-tier diaper cake banded in blue ribbon and burlap with blue hydrangea and a foil monogram topper
